text: BSE (Banco de Seguros del Estado), Uruguay's state insurance bank, is an autonomous state entity belonging to the state's commercial domain (article 1 of its organic law, Ley 18.243); its assets and the state's responsibility guarantee its operations (article 20).
short: BSE is a Uruguayan state entity (state insurance bank)

source.name: IMPO (Uruguay's official law gazette): Ley N° 18.243 (Ley Orgánica del Banco de Seguros del Estado), article 1
source.quote: El Banco de Seguros del Estado, creado por la Ley N° 3.935, de 27 de diciembre de 1911, es un ente autónomo que integra el dominio comercial del Estado
source.note: English: 'The Banco de Seguros del Estado... is an autonomous entity that belongs to the state's commercial domain.' The page is served in Latin-1, so accents drop out when read as UTF-8; the quote matches the page's characters exactly.
